description: This file contains PHP functions related to integrating Twitter in the SuiteCRM project. It includes functions for checking configuration status, formatting tweets, replacing hashtags and user mentions in tweets, duplicate checking in the database, and handling OAuth authentication with Twitter.

methods.name: check_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific module type is enabled in the configuration database.

methods.name: format_feed_tweets
methods.description: Formats tweet text with HTML, truncating if necessary, and adds a link to the full tweet.

methods.name: replace_hashtags
methods.description: Replaces hashtags in the tweet text with HTML links to Twitter hashtag search.

methods.name: replace_users
methods.description: Replaces user mentions in the tweet text with HTML links to Twitter profiles.

methods.name: duplicate_check
methods.description: Checks if a given tweet text and date already exist in the sugarfeed table.

methods.name: check_auth
methods.description: Initiates Twitter OAuth authentication and returns a TwitterOAuth connection object.
